features.missing_rule: exclude symbol; flat if fewer than 24 valid pure-crypto symbols remain
features.source: organizer-authorized point-in-time Binance USD-M pure-crypto snapshot

features.lag: 21 most recent strictly past events per symbol
features.missing_rule: zero carry input for a symbol with no past event; fail closed on malformed or noncausal rows

forbidden_or_unused_fields: bar open/high/low or quote volume for signal construction
current executable open or future membership
positions, fills, equity, PnL, drawdown, or evaluator actions
private qualifier or final OOS data
model_refit: all market paths, residual features, funding carry, and ranks are recomputed at each scheduled decision from past-only rows
